spans.s:
n. (-णं)
Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Putting to shame, outvieing, surpassing.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made ashamed, put to shame.
2 Excelled, surpassed.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., क्त aff.

(ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते)
1 To sound inarticulaly, to neigh as a horse.
2 To go, to move.

f. (-षा)
Neighing as a horse.
E.
ह्रेष to neigh, affs. अ and टाप्.
